<!-- Honest gate: this project is a local-first, domain-agnostic workbench.
     Requests that would hard-code one domain into core tools will be redirected
     to the profile/plugin layer. See CONTRIBUTING.md. -->

**Problem to solve**

What are you trying to do, and where does the current tool fall short? (A use case beats a solution sketch.)

**Proposed behavior**

What should happen instead, concretely?

**Fit check**

- [ ] This works for any domain profile, not just my own use case (or I explained where the domain boundary should be)
- [ ] It does not require uploading personal data anywhere (local-first stays local-first)
- [ ] It does not weaken the honesty red lines (no fabricated resume/analysis content)

**Alternatives considered**

What did you try, or what existing workaround exists?
